text: なく　こも　だまらせるぜ！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: Changing だまる 'to go quiet' to だまらせる means making someone else do it. だまらせる = 'make shut up'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: The verb before こ tells you which child is meant. なく　こ = 'a child who is crying'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly emphasis. だまらせるぜ = 'we'll make them shut up, I tell ya'.
